images.title: Cut and slide a parallelogram
images.purpose: Shows a parallelogram turned into a rectangle of equal area by moving one triangle.
images.composition: Before and after: parallelogram on the left, rectangle on the right, one plain arrow between them.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. LEFT: parallelogram with a horizontal base 9 units long and height 5 units; its top side is shifted 3 units to the right of the base. A grey (#6B7280) dashed vertical cut from the top left corner down to the base, with a right angle mark, cuts off a right triangle with legs 3 (along the base) and 5 (up). That triangle is filled amber (#E69F00); the rest (a trapezium) is filled teal (#0072B2). Label 9 cm under the base and 5 cm beside the dashed line. MIDDLE: one plain dark arrow pointing right. RIGHT: a rectangle 9 units wide and 5 units tall: the same teal trapezium with the amber triangle now fitted against its right slanting edge, filling it exactly. Label 9 cm under it, 5 cm beside it, and 45 cm² in the centre. Check: 9 × 5 = 45.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Moving one triangle across turns the parallelogram into a rectangle with the same area.
images.description: Shows a parallelogram turned into a rectangle of equal area by moving one triangle.
images.context: Matches the worked example: base 9 cm, height 5 cm, area 45 cm². Dissection.
images.teaching_notes: Keep the amber triangle identical in size on both sides so the child sees nothing lost.

image_decisions.why: Dissection is a before and after move; one paired diagram shows it directly.
